services.name: Fishing - Inshore
services.desc: Few places in the Northeast hold the fishing history and ecological richness of Narragansett Bay. Its intricate blend of rocky shorelines, deep channels, and nutrient-dense currents forms a thriving highway for New England’s most sought-after game fish. On this private charter, Captain Donald Cook guides you through the bay’s ever-changing secret spots using light tackle for maximum fight and maximum fun. From targeting trophy Striped Bass and hard-striking Blues to filling the cooler with fresh Black Sea Bass and Flounder, this is an immersive journey into the heartbeat of Rhode Island fishing.
